verdict.rationale: First-party material documents built-in high availability, automatic Raft leader election in the open-source server, an HA option and auto scaling on dedicated Typesense Cloud clusters, and a public 32M-song demo. That is real clustering and replication support. However, the pack has no detailed clustering or replication guide and no sharding or horizontal-partitioning path, and community commenters doubt that an in-memory, non-sharded engine scales to very large datasets. missing for 10: documented clustering/replication setup guide, sharding or horizontal scale-out path, evidence of deployments at hundreds of millions of documents, independent hands-on corroboration of HA behavior.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, documented scaling paths — clustering, replication, high availability — carry me from prototype to hundreds of millions of documents
